description: The tracked keywords of your organization with their stats, poll health, matching rules and context, plus `total`. Without arguments: every keyword, newest first. Search the term and context (q), narrow by kinds, statuses (active, muted by a person, paused by the wallet, noisy: paused by the noise brake, capped at its monthly mention cap), platforms or groupIds, order (sort) and page (limit, offset).

groupId.description: Deprecated: use groupIds, the same filter; both are read as one list.

groupIds.description: Only keywords in any of these groups (grp_...). Repeatable, or comma-separated.

kind.description: Deprecated: use kinds, the same filter; both are read as one list.

kinds.description: Only these kinds: brand, competitor, topic. Repeatable, or comma-separated.

limit.description: Page size, 1 to 500. Omit for every keyword after `offset`.

notGroupIds.description: Never keywords in these groups (grp_...). Repeatable, or comma-separated.

notKinds.description: Never these kinds. Repeatable, or comma-separated.

notPlatforms.description: Never keywords tracked on any of these platforms (by the same reading as platforms). Repeatable, or comma-separated.

items.description: Platform: bluesky, hackernews, github, stackoverflow, devto, reddit, x, youtube, news, linkedin, tiktok, instagram, facebook, appstore (App Store reviews), googleplay (Google Play reviews), trustpilot (Trustpilot reviews), googlemaps (Google reviews of a place), rss (RSS and Atom feeds a keyword reads).

notStatuses.description: Never keywords in these states. Repeatable, or comma-separated.

items.description:

- muted: switched off by a person.

- capped: at its mention cap until its period turns.
